name: Icon map
author: Brett
description: Every icon, badge and logo slot in every app, plugin and screen (icon-map@1), with the icon pack in force and per-slot picks. The page lists and searches the map with a live preview; switching the pack changes every icon at once, a pick changes one place. Everything is on the API too: REST /api/plugins/icon-map (map, tree, roles, glyphs, packs, state, pack, slot, resolve, check), MCP icon-map_* tools and the CLI (axf icon-map …, node framework/cli/icon-map.mjs), and voice ('switch to the duotone icon pack'). State lives in the plugin's data folder; the open console follows it.

items.title: The icon map
items.description: Every slot, or the ones matching q / app / owner / surface / kind / role / glyph (icon-map@1).

items.title: The icon map as a tree
items.description: app → owner → surface → slots.

items.title: Icon roles
items.description: Every role with its default glyph and group.

items.title: Framework glyphs
items.description: The framework glyph names and aliases.

items.title: Icon packs
items.description: Every icon-pack@1 asset: style, themable, covers, roles, glyphs, licence.

items.title: Icon state
items.description: The icon pack in force and every per-slot pick.

items.title: One slot
items.description: A slot by id, with what it draws now and why.

items.title: What a place draws
items.description: name / slot / role → the glyph and the step that decided it (override, pack role, pack glyph, framework, fallback).

items.title: Icon map check
items.description: What CI runs: hard-coded icons not in the map, raw icons beyond the baseline.

items.title: Switch the icon pack
items.description: Use an icon pack (by id, name or style word, e.g. duotone) in every app that follows the console. Changes every icon at once.

items.title: Back to the branding's icon pack
items.description: Drops the hand pick; the branding package's (or skin's) pack is in force again.

items.title: Pick one slot's icon
items.description: Draw a glyph in one place (a slot id from the map).

items.title: Drop one slot's pick
items.description: Back to the pack's role mapping or the framework glyph for that place.

items.title: Icon pack template
items.description: One icon-pack@1 file mapping every role in the map to a glyph (from a pack, else the role defaults). Edit a role to change every place of that role; apply the pack to change every icon at once.

items.title: Restore one slot
items.description: Restore previous edit (from: previous) or Restore from axHub (from: hub, the icons as axHub had them when the console last loaded the look).

items.title: Restore the icon pack
items.description: The pack before the last change (from: previous) or axHub's (from: hub).

items.title: Record axHub's icons
items.description: The open console sends the icons axHub's look document holds (pack + per-slot picks) when it loads; Restore from axHub reads this.

items.title: Imported icon packs
items.description: The icon packs imported into this console (whole icon-pack@1 assets, kept in the plugin's data folder).

items.title: Import an icon pack
items.description: Validate an icon-pack@1 asset (e.g. an edited template) and keep it; it joins the pack list in every transport.

items.title: Remove an imported icon pack
items.description: Drops an imported pack (and any pick or skin default that used it).

items.title: Export an icon pack
items.description: One pack as its icon-pack@1 asset file, shipped or imported.

items.title: Per-skin default icon packs
items.description: Every skin, the pack it names, the default set here and what it draws.

items.title: Set a skin's default icon pack
items.description: The pack this skin draws while no pack is picked by hand.

items.title: Drop a skin's default icon pack
items.description: The skin draws the pack it names itself again.

items.title: Icon packs shared on axHub
items.description: The shared icon-pack table on axHub, as the open console last read it (icon-map.hub.refresh reads again).

items.title: Record axHub's shared icon packs
items.description: The open console sends what it read from axHub's shared icon-pack table.

items.title: Switch the icon pack (in the open console)
items.description: Argument: a pack id, name or style word.

items.title: Back to the branding's icon pack (in the open console)
Pick one slot's icon (in the open console)
items.description: Argument: <slot id>:<glyph>.

items.title: Drop one slot's pick (in the open console)
items.description: Argument: the slot id.

items.title: Open one slot in the icon map
items.description: Argument: the slot id. Opens the page on that slot's panel: previews, why it draws what it draws, and the glyph grid to change it.

items.title: Restore one slot (in the open console)
items.description: Argument: <slot id>:previous or <slot id>:hub.

items.title: Restore the icon pack (in the open console)
items.description: Argument: previous or hub.

items.title: Download the icon pack template
items.description: Argument (optional): the pack to start from.

items.title: Export an icon pack (download, in the open console)
items.description: Argument: the pack id.

items.title: Import an icon pack (in the open console)
items.description: Argument: the pack JSON; none opens the page's import box.

items.title: Remove an imported icon pack (in the open console)
items.description: Argument: the pack id.

items.title: Share an icon pack on axHub
items.description: Argument: the pack id. Puts it in axHub's shared icon-pack table for every app on the project (needs the axHub sign-in).

items.title: Read the icon packs shared on axHub
Set a skin's default icon pack (in the open console)
items.description: Argument: <skin id>:<pack>.
